meta.notes: OSM traffic-camera coverage in Jordan is sparse and community-driven: many real installations are untagged, and mapped ones are often unnamed or unmaintained. Treat this corpus as a floor, not ground truth - keep verified:false, refresh by re-running tools/src/import_osm.py, and cross-check new mappings in OSM. The checkpoint/bump categories come from other sources; this importer does not query them.
